# GraphRAG Local and Global Community Summarization

> Microsoft GraphRAG architecture combining entity extraction, hierarchical community detection, and map-reduce global summarization.

## Core Findings

- Microsoft GraphRAG's global search generates corpus-wide answers by executing map-reduce summarization across hierarchical community reports, achieving 72%–83% win rates on comprehensiveness and 75%–82% on diversity over naive vector RAG on million-token datasets (p < 0.001). [Source: https://arxiv.org/abs/2404.16130]
- Root-level community summaries (C0) compress source text by approximately 97% while maintaining superior comprehensiveness (72% win rate) over baseline semantic search on corpus-spanning sensemaking queries. [Source: https://arxiv.org/abs/2404.16130]
- For localized factual lookups (single-hop 'who/what/when' queries), naive vector RAG achieves higher directness and lower latency than global community summarization, indicating that hybrid architectures routing by query specificity minimize compute cost. [Source: https://arxiv.org/abs/2404.16130]
